scientific_integrity: The result is proved for every even n>=12. Direct finite checks are supplementary, not infinite certification. The unrestricted minimum is not determined.
scientific_limitations: Only two-subset Kneser graphs with even ground-set order at least twelve are covered.
Weight four is proved optimal only within the explicitly defined cut-pattern family, not among arbitrary signed Roman functions.
The displayed counting formula enumerates one constructive family and not all weight-four labelings.
Possible uncatalogued or inaccessible equivalent prior literature remains a priority risk.
title: A degree criterion and weight-four signed Roman patterns in even Kneser graphs
